sources.label: Official Gymshark men's size guide (Menswear Tops chart, cm)

audit: Was XXS–XXL with UK/US/EU conversions Gymshark doesn't publish for men. Official Menswear Tops chart is XS–3XL, chest and waist only, and much larger: XS chest 87 → 94, waist 71 → 75; M chest 97 → 104, waist 82 → 85; XL chest 110 → 114 (waist unchanged); 3XL added; XXS removed. Bottoms chart has the same waist figures.
notes: UK activewear brand. Gymshark's men's chart is letter sizes XS–3XL by chest and waist; it publishes no UK/US/EU conversions for menswear. Compression and fitted styles feel tighter; Crest range and lifestyle pieces are more relaxed. Very high presence on Vinted and eBay second-hand.
